title: Bugs
description: The bugs handed to proof, the owner's first and then the planter's, each name used once; and how many the planter wrote, none when it did not run.

planted.description: How many bugs the planter wrote: none when the slice has no bugs-caught item or the builder stopped.

stayed.description: The planter's branch, when worktrees kept it, with the reason it gave; empty when it was dropped or no planter ran.

reason.description: worktrees.drop-branch's sentence: why the branch was kept and what would let it go.
